name: spread-after
source:
declare const overrides: Record<string, string>;
export const Direction = { Up: "UP", ...overrides } as const;

name: spread-before
source:
declare const overrides: Record<string, string>;
export const Direction = { ...overrides, Up: "UP" } as const;

name: computed-after
source:
declare const key: string;
export const Direction = { Up: "UP", [key]: "DOWN" } as const;

name: quoted-override
source: export const Direction = { Up: "UP", "Up": "DOWN" } as const;

name: standalone
source: export const Direction = { Up: "UP" } as const;

name: duplicate-scalars
source: export const Direction = { Up: "UP", Up: "DOWN" } as const;

name: accessor-after
source: export const Direction = { Up: "UP", get Up() { return "DOWN"; } } as const;

name: accessor-before
source: export const Direction = { get Up() { return "DOWN"; }, Up: "UP" } as const;

name: computed-before
source:
declare const key: string;
export const Direction = { [key]: "DOWN", Up: "UP" } as const;

name: mutable-annotation
source:
export const Direction: { Up: string } = { Up: "UP" } as const;
Direction.Up = "DOWN";
